summary: 1940 International Derrick steel lookout on Swancott Hill, Lewis County; closed after 1971, removed, and a tower at Randall, Cortland County is listed as relocated.

facts.status_note: Removed from Swancott Hill. The association lists a standing tower at Randall, Cortland County, as relocated from here; the association lists it as private.

access.note: The tower and cabin are gone. Swancott Hill State Forest is state land with no formal hiking trails. The onX guide says the old site ends at private property and asks visitors to respect the signs.

visit.trail_note: onX lists a 1.8-mile route to the old tower site, which ends at private property.

facts.agency: New York State Conservation Department (per the 1939 announcement)

events.note: Erection of a State Conservation Department fire observation tower on Swancott Hill announced (Forest Lookouts)
Starr dates the International Derrick model 1933 tower to 1940; onX says the CCC built it in 1940
Closed at the end of the 1971 season as aerial detection came in; tower and cabin then sold and removed (onX)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1939 is the year the erection was announced; 1940 is the build year given by Starr and the onX guide.

onX dates the closure to the end of the 1971 season and says the tower and cabin were then sold and removed, without a year. Starr says the tower was dismantled in the mid-1970s. Neither gives an exact removal year.

notes_for_editor: Removal date conflicts: onX gives the 1971 closure and a sale-and-removal with no year; Starr says mid-1970s. The relocation to Randall rests on the FFLA NY list and one group post; the list gives the name Randall and marks the entry 'Private' (it has no owner column), but no page we read gives the location or the owner. Height 30.4 m is converted from Starr's 99 ft 9 in to the cab floor. The record elevation_m is null; Starr lists the hill at 1,500 ft, which an editor could use. The state forest's public status comes from the DEC page; the access level 'restricted' is our judgement from the onX note about private property at the site.
